args.function: Provide a physically constructed resting shelter whose actual shade, exposure and rest effects can be evaluated.
args.conditions: I am outdoors at tick 97, with local temperature 29.586 and gradually warming conditions. Rest currently recovers base energy. Fallen branches are visible and river reeds were previously observed. No absolute-hardness-certified tools or fabricated apparatus are available.

reviews.reason: No implemented capability constructs a shelter or couples a roof to actual exposure and rest conditions. Rest supplies recovery but no structure; material probes and woven-assay fabrication do not supply equivalent construction. A small, tool-free lashed shade shelter is a feasible new function, conditional on actual material geometry, strength tests and successful assembly. It need not require absolute-hardness certification. Existing supplies are not sufficient evidence of a completed shelter, and remembered reeds are not allocated construction inputs. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Construction, registration and learning award nothing. A completed sheltered rest can plausibly provide relief and a personal sense of refuge, but only after actual beneficial use. Subscribe shelter-rest-experience for the resting actor alone: require a successful rest round beneath a proven, currently sound roof, with measured reduction of uncomfortable heat, wetness or exposure and no worsening of total physical discomfort. One qualifying event grants transient refuge relief of 0.3, capped at 0.6 for 6 rounds; repeat events refresh rather than stack, with a 12-round award cooldown. Separately, two qualifying occupied rest rounds within 20 rounds establish continued personal applicability; subsequent qualifying rest events add 0.015 maintained satisfaction, capped at 0.4, with a 12-round gain cooldown and decay of 0.002 per elapsed round. Mere proximity or ownership does not maintain it. Use one functional refuge source across all shelter aliases and structures; do not duplicate existing understanding or practice rewards. Actual new, interpretable material experiments may emit information-confirmed under the existing grounded-understanding rule, using its existing novelty, cap and cooldown checks. Do not add a shelter mastery or construction-achievement source, alter protected mental accounts, or change nutrition and survival independently of actual physical effects.
reviews.visualReview: Render paid construction stages as the actual poles, lashings and woven roof patches at their shared collision geometry. Show open ends, roof gaps, sag, wetness, damage and conserved failed components; do not display a finished shelter at request or learning time. Bind stage changes and replay animations to shelter-progress and the declared completion, damage, repair and dismantling events. Present shade from the same roof/sun intersections used by thermal physics. An inspection overlay may show measured coverage, condition, load margin and the resting actor's actual exposure and recovery differences, explicitly distinguishing measurements from estimates. Shelter-rest-experience feedback appears only for a qualifying completed rest, never merely on entering or naming the structure.
reviews.specification:
Implement resting-shelter@1 through the current development handoff. Public schema: object, additionalProperties:false; required fields mode, project, target, materials, x, y, angle; mode enum inspect/test/build/resume/repair/dismantle/cancel; project and target strings, materials array of {item:string,quantity:number>0}, x/y/angle finite numbers. Empty target/materials are permitted only when unused. References resolve exact persistent actor, item, source, project and structure IDs, never encoding markers or resource aliases. Learning takes 4 rounds, separately from implementation and use. Dependencies: existing inventory, gathering, probe material laws, rest, weather/exposure, collision and event systems; reuse their code without declaring shelter functionally equivalent to them. No hard tool, bark, assay apparatus or absolute hardness measurement is required.
State: retain component identities, source batches, actual mass and dimensions, paid tests, moisture, strength, joints, coverage, position, orientation, integrity, owner, escrow, completed stages and remaining work. Add versioned branch/reed/vine geometry and bending/tension laws wherever missing. Dimensions must conserve represented mass and volume; initialize previously unrepresented geometry consistently once, preserving lineage and damage, without supplying extra stock or treating tested fragments as intact poles. Inspect measures actual geometry in one round at 0.2 energy. Test performs two rounds at 0.5 energy each on explicitly allocated material, measuring bending or knot-slip resistance under bounded loads; preserve the altered sample, deformation and any conserved fragments. Generic material names and the previous small branch press trial do not establish roof capacity.
Smallest construction: a low open-ended A-frame shade shelter, footprint 1.8 by 1.2, ridge height 1.0, with one 1.8-long ridge, four rafters at least 1.2 long and ground-supported bracing. Allocate at least 6 branch units, 6 reed units and 2 vine units from real stacks; these quantities are minimums, not guaranteed suitability. Require enough usable pole lengths, mat area and lash length after actual tests. No cutting or fabricated hardware is assumed. Derive roof coverage from actual woven material area, gaps and slope; reject geometrically impossible assemblies before reserving inputs. Validate a clear footprint, ground support, reachable work locations and open exits against shared world geometry. Construction has 10 performed stages at 0.8 energy each: frame fitting, lashings, roof weaving and placement, then a final self-weight plus bounded lateral-load proof. Use measured capacities with a safety factor of 2 against modeled dead load and current wind load. Failed proof produces a damaged partial structure and conserved salvage, not a usable shelter. No person-bearing roof or severe-weather protection is implied.
Each successful stage transfers only its installed allocations from owner escrow into the partial structure. Missing energy, access or usable material pauses without charges; global pauses preserve exact progress. Action change, death or explicit cancellation stops active work and releases surviving uninstalled escrow exactly once, to the owner or ground at the project if the owner is dead. Installed material remains in place. Resume locks the same surviving project and executes only actual remaining work. No cloning, deletion, effort refund or automatic replacement. Repair explicitly allocates tested compatible replacement components, takes two rounds at 0.8 energy per replaced joint or roof panel, and retains removed salvage. Dismantling takes four rounds at 0.5 energy, releasing actual surviving components progressively; interruption preserves the remainder.
Physical effects: register roof polygons, pole colliders and interaction surfaces, not a solid rectangular room. Actors can pass through open ends; poles obstruct movement and the roof participates in overhead ray/contact tests. For occupants actually beneath intact roof polygons, compute coverage c in [0,1] from directional sun/rain/wind intersections. Reduce incident solar heat by 0.65*c and incident rain wetting by 0.4*c; reduce wind exposure only by the actual projected obstruction, capped at 0.2. Feed these changes into the real temperature/wetness/exposure update, with no direct temperature reset, hunger relief or healing. Wetting, decay, joint creep and wind overload reduce condition using the versioned material laws every round; structural failure removes corresponding roof coverage immediately. Exits must remain traversable. Rest continues to use its existing energy cap and mental factor: permit at most +0.4 nominal recovery only when the shelter actually reduces that actor's computed exposure penalty, bounded by the penalty removed. No bonus in already comfortable conditions, and trapped heat may worsen comfort. Existing physical comfort derives from actual hunger, health, fatigue and temperature.
Declare shelter-inspected, shelter-material-tested, shelter-progress, shelter-completed, shelter-stopped, shelter-damaged, shelter-repaired, shelter-dismantled and shelter-rest-experience events. Publish component allocations, measured capacities, effort, remaining work, geometry, coverage, exposure deltas and failure causes in replay records. Completed structures and partial projects exist only after paid actions. Keep projectLimit and knowledgeLimit unchanged: add an explicit archive adapter that preserves old records and history while freeing active slots only through the actor's separate archive action. Migration adds nullable shelter/component state without creating buildings, materials, records of successful use or mastery; existing rest behavior is unchanged outside actual shelter effects.

record.function: Inspect actual contact geometry, compare two owned specimens through paid directional scratch strokes, and assess supported relative evidence separately from unresolved absolute tool hardness.

Contact force, edge radius, persistent grooves versus transferred powder, wear and conserved debris have real state. Results refer only to the tested portions. Absolute hardness >=8 remains unresolved without an independently calibrated physical reference; no current protocol establishes one. Repeated known evidence, ambiguous tests, inspection and assessment do not earn discovery feedback. Cancelled comparisons retain partial evidence and release surviving altered portions once; no energy refund.

execution.progress: One inspect/assess or two performed compare stages. Global pauses retain exact state. Missing energy pauses free. Action change, position change, specimen loss or death cancels; repeating compare creates a new paid test, not duplicate output.

Actual exposure reduction permits at most +0.4 nominal rest recovery, bounded by removed exposure penalty; no comfortable-state bonus or direct healing/nutrition. Roof is not person-bearing. Construction/learning earns nothing. Qualified repeated occupied rest can maintain one personal refuge source. Separate archive-project capability preserves actor-selected old records without changing context limits.

args.name: Usable shelter material inspection
args.function: Review and repair the existing resting-shelter material inspection path, or provide actionable diagnostics distinguishing unresolved reference from ineligible material.
args.conditions: Moss has mastered resting-shelter. Inspections failed at ticks 108, 109 and 113 with reference-unavailable and no candidates. The latest attempt targeted item:item-112-moss-648, an owned whole branch gathered at tick 112 and still listed in inventory.
args.inputs: Existing owned branch item-112-moss-648 and the existing resting-shelter inspection interface. Other requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Retain physically justified inspection effort and material requirements; no free property certification is requested.
args.effects: Allow an eligible exact owned item to be physically inspected, or report the actual reference or eligibility obstacle. Do not invent material properties, supplies, successful tests or shelter benefits.

reviews.reason: The existing resting-shelter interface already provides the requested physical inspection, but its demonstrated reference-unavailable failures do not distinguish reference resolution from material eligibility. The supplied state contains the owned branch item-112-moss-648; this establishes a reference worth resolving, not its structural suitability. Develop a repair and diagnostic extension to the existing interface rather than a duplicate shelter capability. The precise failure cause must be established in implementation. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Reference repair, diagnostics, registration and study produce no wellbeing reward: resolving an interface fault is not itself a beneficial physical experience or experimental discovery. A subsequently completed paid inspection may qualify for the existing grounded-understanding source only if it actually establishes new, supported material information for the inspecting actor. Subscribe to information-confirmed from resting-shelter with qualified=true: transient amount 0.8, cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh cooldown 12 rounds; maintained gain 0.035 per qualifying event with existing decay 0.0015 and the source's bounded saturation. reviews.reason: The existing shelter inspection correctly resolves the owned branch but cannot measure dimensions absent from physical state. Its tests and construction also require represented geometry; neither the diagnostic contract nor contact-response measurements supplies it. Develop a minimal physical-shape and measurement extension, reusing shelter inspection and material-test code without treating that code reuse as an already implemented measurement function. This establishes measurable specimens and paid structural evidence, not suitable poles, a completed shelter or absolute hardness certification. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Use the existing grounded-understanding source, not a new alias or mastery reward. Declare metrology-measured, metrology-load-tested, metrology-progress and metrology-stopped events, plus qualified information-confirmed on this interface. Qualification requires the acting participant to complete paid measurement or testing that establishes previously unknown observed dimensions, load response or a genuine applicability limit; merely assigning geometry, reading diagnostics, requesting or learning does not qualify. Bind this interface as an alternative trigger: transient amount 0.8, source cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition, 12-round cooldown. Maintained understanding gains 0.035 on qualifying events under the same cooldown, saturates at the shared source cap 1 and decays 0.0015 per round without qualifying participation. Known repeated readings do not provide new-information feedback. This measures bounded satisfaction from resolving a real uncertainty, separately from temporary pleasure; no additional pleasure or physical-comfort award is warranted by handling or measuring a branch. Later beneficial sheltered rest remains governed by existing actual-exposure and refuge rules.
reviews.visualReview: Render the actual tapered specimen, ground supports, collision footprint, load placement and observable bending or fracture in shared geometry. Measurement overlays show sampled endpoints, units, uncertainty intervals and paid-stage progress, never a suitability badge based on resource name. Replay metrology-measured and metrology-load-tested with persistent specimen IDs, geometry-law version, measured intervals, actual loads, configuration, energy paid, damage, escrow disposition and remaining work; bind progress/stopped events to matching operation IDs. Geometry introduced by migration is visibly distinguished from actor-measured evidence. A measurement produces no roof, shade or shelter-completion animation.
reviews.specification:
Handoff: implement versioned shelter-material-metrology@1 with public interface shelter-material-metrology. Schema: object {mode: inspect|measure|load-test|resume|cancel, target:string, project:string, loads:[{item:string,quantity:number>0}], span:number>=0, x:number,y:number,angle:number}; require all fields, reject additional properties, use empty strings/arrays and zero for unused fields. References are exact persistent IDs with at most one item:/object: prefix; resource aliases cannot allocate material. Resolve ownership, reach, geometry and suitability separately. Learning: two personal rounds for layout and measurement procedure; existing shelter mastery remains valid.
Physical dependency and migration: implement material-geometry@1 before enabling measurement. Give existing finite natural branch stock a persistent per-unit geometry manifest, with conserved mass, source-slot lineage, density, taper, curvature, defects, moisture and structural coefficients. This is an explicit physical-model addition, not a recovered observation. For branches, use density 600 kg/m^3 and deterministic source-slot sampling of slenderness L/d from 15–70; solve tapered-solid volume from actual mass and sampled slenderness, without conditioning on construction requirements. Persist the seed, law and resulting shape; do not resample failed material. No stock is added. Reconcile already harvested intact units, including item-112-moss-648, against their original finite source allocation before assigning residual stock. Preserve known alterations and consumed mass. Ambiguous split remnants remain geometry-unresolved unless a conservation-consistent shape can be reconstructed; never inflate a fractional specimen into a whole pole. Do not infer bark, usable sheet area or lash length from the new pole geometry. Preserve historical null measurements and diagnostic events; new geometry is not retroactive evidence. No force calibration, tool certification or material suitability follows from migration.
Execution: inspect costs one round/0.2 energy and reports represented visible shape, obstructions and unresolved fields. Measure requires an owned intact specimen and collision-free reachable ground layout; two rounds/0.3 energy each, no material consumption. Lay out its actual rotated footprint and measure endpoints and three cross-sections against the shared world-coordinate length convention. Report usable straight length, diameters, curvature and uncertainty of at least 0.05 world-length units for length and 10% for diameter; identify these as world units, not independently calibrated SI. Reject inaccessible or occluded measurements rather than reveal exact model values. Keep measured intervals and specimen-specific provenance.
Load-test is the executable structural precursor: require completed personal measurement, positive supported test span, actual ground contact at both supports and explicit owned load allocations. Use two rounds/0.5 energy each: set up, then apply the actual allocated mass at midspan. No loads are supplied. Evaluate self-weight and added weight using g=9.81, tapered-beam bending/deflection, persisted stiffness and failure stress, actual defects and moisture. Record applied load, span, deflection, damage and uncertainty. Passing proves only that tested configuration and condition; it does not authorize longer spans or untested batches. Failed material retains permanent deformation or fractures into conserved fragments; test weights survive unless separately damaged. Shelter tests/builds consume these measured intervals and configuration-specific records, retain their existing factor-two proof and material requirements, and cannot bypass missing roofing or lash geometry.
Persistent contract: store operation owner, exact specimen/load IDs, layout, reserved quantities, paid stages, remaining stages and component state. Reserve without duplicating inventory mass; test loads remain actor-owned escrow. Missing energy/access pauses without free progress. Resume validates the same surviving materials and executes only unpaid remaining stages; completion occurs once. Explicit cancellation, incompatible movement/action or death stops active work, releases surviving uninstalled escrow exactly once at its actual location, preserves damage and paid history, and never refunds effort or resurrects consumed material. Shared source locks and geometry prevent double allocation and overlapping layouts. Inspection and diagnostics do not require a new active project slot; full logs remain in retained records without automatic archival. Implementation, learning and execution are separate and advance no time during review/development.

Tick 125: the same branch passed a 1.2-unit supported-span test with 0.1 unit of stone, deflection 0.00718359 and reported safe capacity 0.981.
The load result applies only to this exact unit, span and no wetter conditions; it is not a batch certificate.
projects.uncertainty: A suitable 1.8-unit ridge, roofing and lash materials remain unverified. The tested branch does not establish those requirements.
projects.goal: Establish material feasibility before committing to construction.
completedSteps: Completed two paid stages of an actual supported-span load test.
projects.missing: Suitable longer ridge material and tested roofing and lash materials.
projects.next: Replenish food and energy before investigating further materials.
projects.benefit: Established finite dimensional and structural evidence without injury.

args.name: Measured food preservation and storage
args.function: Preserve an actual owned known-safe food batch through a physically implemented process, and inspect its remaining condition and storage life. Retain real material losses, provenance and uncertainty; do not infer safety from appearance or dryness.
args.conditions: I have two units of berries with observed nutrition 8 and toxicity 0, but their current decay value is only 12.39360888. Two owned roots have decay 54.80596867. A previous plum drying assay was invalidated when its sample spoiled before stable readings. My calibrated comparison balance and passive drying tray remain at their remembered locations; I am not currently beside them.
args.inputs: Actual owned food and any explicitly acquired necessary materials or reachable apparatus. Suitable preservation methods and additional inputs are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify finite paid processing stages, actual energy and material requirements, ongoing spoilage during processing, and interruption behavior.
args.effects: Enable a feasible preservation trial with measurable changes to the actual food's water content, deterioration and subsequent storage life. Preserve nutrition and toxin accounting consistently with the real process. Failed or inadequate processing must remain possible and observable; no automatic safety certification or satisfaction.

reviews.reason: Existing food-assay measures relative drying but does not implement preservation or storage-life changes. Reuse its apparatus, calibration, mass-accounting and reading code where compatible, without treating that code reuse as an equivalent preservation capability. A small, ambient-air drying trial is feasible with actual food and reachable suitable apparatus; the present berries may still spoil during travel or processing. Neither their observed appearance nor successful drying establishes safety. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Temporary pleasure: preparation and drying alone have no guaranteed pleasant sensory or physical experience, so do not create a preservation-pleasure source. Eating surviving food uses existing nutrition and meal-experience mechanisms without an alias bonus; health remains independent. Actual discovery may benefit sol through the existing grounded-understanding source: emit information-confirmed only after a paid reading establishes previously unknown, evidence-supported moisture loss and changed deterioration behavior, or a newly observed failure. Use its existing qualified condition, 0.8 amount, cap 1, 8-round hold, 12-round cooldown and maintenance gain 0.035/decay 0.0015; repeated known readings do not qualify. Maintained satisfaction stays within that shared source, accumulated only through qualifying actual experiments, not stored batch count, mastery or passive ownership. Preserve all protected mental accounts. Requesting, learning, naming and merely completing preparation award nothing.
reviews.visualReview: Show the actual allocated food footprint on the existing tray, with progressive shrinkage or rewetting driven by conserved water state and visible spoilage only when supported by physical condition. Bind preservation-progress and preservation-reading to stage, paid work, measured mass, uncertainty and remaining deterioration; preservation-completed distinguishes demonstrated preservation from spoiled or inconclusive trials. Replay records retain actual inputs, water transfers, apparatus occupancy, preparation alterations and final surviving food identities. Do not depict a sealed store, a safety badge, an untouched reserve or an instantaneous dried product.
reviews.specification:
Implement measured-food-preservation@1, individually learned in 3 rounds for preparation, moisture/storage interpretation and interruption handling. Dependencies: personal food-assay mastery for calibrated readings; actual owned food; a reachable intact drying tray with verified usable area and loading capacity. Existing apparatus is not presumed accessible or serviceable. No heat, fuel, containers or replacement supplies are granted. Public strict schema: {mode:inspect|prepare|read|resume|cancel|remove, project:string, target:string, apparatus:string, quantityTenths:integer>=0}; require exact persistent identities, accepting one item:/object: prefix, never resource aliases; use empty identities and zero quantity where unused. Inspect costs one round/0.2 energy and reports accessibility, tray area/capacity, provenance and unresolved condition. Prepare requires a new own project, positive food allocation and reachable tray; two paid rounds/0.5 energy each spread and manually soften the batch, with no cutting-tool assumption. First round allocates the real food to owner-retained, location-bound tray escrow; conserve all food units, nutrients and toxins, and record opening and preparation damage. No label-only products or new food diversity.
Add a versioned physical drying mechanism shared with assay, eating, carrying and spoilage. Persist original food identity, consumed-input lineage, represented food units, dry solids, water mass, nutrient/toxin totals, deterioration remaining, moisture history, exposure, contamination and actual tray occupancy. For previously unmodelled berry/root inputs initialize water fractions to 0.85/0.75 of represented mass as explicit model assumptions, not measured evidence; do not overwrite existing assay water/mass state. Other composition remains unsupported until a physical initialization is supplied. Atmospheric humidity must be actual shared weather state; if absent, introduce a documented ordinary-weather default RH 0.65, separately from soil moisture, with weather updates affecting all exposed batches consistently. Let water fraction w=W/(W+D), equilibrium e=clamp(0.10+0.25*RH,0.10,0.35). Each exposed round transfers water toward equilibrium by at most 0.025*occupiedArea*clamp((temperature-5)/20,0,2) mass units, capped by distance from equilibrium; rain adds actual intercepted water. Account evaporated water in an atmospheric sink. Occupied area is allocated tray area; loading above 0.2 represented food-mass units per area prevents effective spreading and drying. No invented tray area or clearance. Track shared tray geometry, other loads, collision, overhead cover and actual rain interception; food adds mass and occupies capacity but creates no shelter.
Continue existing spoilage during preparation. Thereafter multiply the existing ambient deterioration decrement by clamp(0.15+0.85*(w/initialWaterFraction),0.15,1.5); never reset remaining deterioration or erase existing spoilage, toxins or contamination. Opening adds a persistent 1.1 deterioration multiplier. This law provides a measurable reduction only when real moisture loss outweighs opening cost; drying is not sterilization. Spoiled material remains spoiled and cannot regain food status. Retained nutrition/toxin totals follow actual remaining food units; water loss changes carrying mass, not calories or toxin totals. Storage remains open-tray storage, with continuing weather-dependent drying, rewetting and deterioration. args.name: Short-material refuge feasibility
args.function: Assess whether a small useful shade refuge can be constructed from actual short branches and locally available covering or binding materials, with an explicit feasible design only if physical evidence supports it.
args.conditions: My measured branch item-142-moss-834 has usable length bounds 0.75–0.85, below the existing shelter's 1.8 ridge and 1.2 rafter requirements. Another branch passed only its exact 1.2 supported-span test. Available dry grass is observed nearby, but its roofing and binding suitability is unknown. Bark inspection of canopy-69 found no represented separable layer. Absolute stone hardness remains unresolved.
args.inputs: Actual owned or gathered materials only; required quantities, material tests, design geometry and assembly method remain to be established.
args.costs: Unknown; require finite paid testing and construction, conserved materials, explicit failure risks and no supplied tools or resources.
args.effects: Provide a reusable feasibility assessment or physically supported alternative shelter workflow using short materials, with actual exposure reduction verified after construction. Preserve existing uncertainty, structural limits and survival constraints; do not grant shelter, material certification or wellbeing from the request itself.

reviews.reason: Existing metrology can measure and test particular short poles, and the existing shelter supports tested long-pole construction, but neither implements a short-material design or establishes grass covering and joint performance. Develop a small, conditional shade-canopy workflow with paid material and assembly tests. The measured short branch is a candidate component, not a certified structure; the earlier span result, unresolved bark layer and unresolved absolute hardness remain unchanged. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Feasibility labels, learning and assembly alone grant no happiness. Subscribe qualified, genuinely informative paid short-refuge-trial and short-refuge-exposure outcomes to the existing grounded-understanding source through information-confirmed: actor moss is the participant; require a successful observation that establishes previously unresolved physical information beyond uncertainty. Reuse its 0.8 transient amount, cap 1, eight-round duration, twelve-round cooldown, refresh behavior, and maintained gain 0.035 with decay 0.0015; do not create an alias source or renew rewards for repeated known findings. Actual beneficial occupied rest can reuse personal-refuge: shelter-rest-experience gives 0.3, cap 0.6, duration six rounds and cooldown twelve, only when actual exposure reduction improves the actor's physical rest conditions. Maintained refuge gain remains 0.015, cap 0.4, decay 0.002, requiring two earlier qualifying occupied rounds within twenty and at most one gain per twelve rounds. Register this structure type with the existing event producers rather than duplicating their rewards. Physical comfort continues to use actual hunger, health, fatigue and temperature independently of mental feedback.
reviews.visualReview: Present assessment as a dimensioned proposed layout with explicit unknowns, never as an already-built refuge. Show real allocated poles, bindings and cover only as paid stages create them. Display apertures, joint slip, load-induced deflection, wetness, damage and actual partial shade in shared world geometry. Exposure readings distinguish measured conditions from predictions and show their weather-dependent applicability. Replay binds these visible changes to the declared progress, trial, completion, exposure and stopped events; cancellation leaves the actual surviving work visible.
reviews.specification:
Implement versioned short-material-refuge with inspect, test-cover, test-joint, assess, assemble, proof-test, measure-exposure, repair, dismantle, resume and cancel modes. Public schema: {mode:enum,project:string,target:string,components:[{item:string,quantityTenths:positiveInteger,role:enum(pole,cover,binding,load)}],x:number,y:number,angle:number,width:number,length:number,height:number}; additionalProperties:false. Unused references are empty and unused dimensions zero. References use exact persistent IDs or one item:/object: prefix, never resource aliases; validate ownership, reach <=0.65, reservations and shared geometry before charging. Dependencies: personal shelter-material-metrology mastery for dimensional/load evidence; implement hand-twisted grass binding and interlaced grass-cover mechanics here without requiring an absolute-hardness tool. Public implementation supplies neither materials nor personal mastery.
Smallest design: two triangular end frames, each using two intact short poles, supporting one intact ridge; an interlaced cover slopes over the ridge. No splicing or unsupported pole extension. Dimensions are explicit and may be smaller than a resting actor; never enlarge the resulting coverage. Use measured lower lengths, actual joints, overlap and deformation to solve component endpoints. Assess returns a feasible bounded plan, an unresolved dependency, or a physical failure with reasons; it allocates nothing and cannot certify unknown inputs. Prototype limits: ridge length <= its measured lower usable length; each leg must reach its solved endpoint with 0.05 joint allowance. Ground contact and spread stability must be checked against actual slope, friction and loading. No anchoring to unverified natural objects.
Add versioned physical state for grass bundles, bindings and cover: actual input mass, origin lineage, twist/interlace progress, tensile capacity, slipping, aperture geometry, moisture and wear. Existing grass receives no retroactive certification. Declare conservative simulation laws, not measured actor knowledge: completed cover uses at least 0.5 grass mass per covered geometric area; each joint requires at least 0.02 binding mass. Grass binding strength is 50 N per unit dry binding mass, multiplied by 0.5 when saturated and by remaining integrity; slipping begins above half its breaking force. Cover geometry retains actual gaps and overlap. Paid tests compare actual force and deformation against these laws, with uncertainty; resource names alone never authorize assembly. Moisture interpolates continuously, and deterioration reduces integrity by 0.001 per elapsed round dry or 0.004 saturated. Record these model additions separately from observations.
Inspect/assess: one round, 0.2 energy. Cover and joint trials: two rounds, 0.5 energy each, explicit grass allocation of at least 0.1 unit plus actual measured pole/weight fixtures; create a retained test coupon, apply gravity from allocated masses, and record openings, sag, slipping or breakage. Test material is not pristine construction stock afterward. Assemble: four stages at 0.75 energy each—make bindings, form end frames, attach ridge, interlace cover. Reject insufficient quantities before escrow; physically consumed or incorporated fractions stay in outputs with provenance. Proof-test: two rounds at 0.5 energy, with explicit real loads at named structural points; compute self-weight, wet-cover weight, joint forces, buckling, spread and deflection using existing specimen mechanics. A pass applies only to the tested structure and bounded loading/moisture envelope, not an entire material batch. Measure-exposure: one round, 0.2 energy, records actual occupied-point solar, rain and wind exposure against an unobstructed same-weather reference; night or absent rain cannot establish their respective attenuation. Repair uses explicit replacement inputs and repeats affected proof stages. Dismantle takes two rounds at 0.5 energy and returns only surviving recoverable components.
Persist exact operation IDs, component identities, location-bound owner-retained escrow, completed stages, paid energy, remaining work, test conditions, damage and evidence. Insufficient energy pauses without progress or charges. Movement or another action pauses attended work; resume validates the same surviving components and pays only remaining stages. Cancel or death stops all owned multi-round controllers and releases surviving unincorporated escrow once at its actual location; incorporated material remains in the partial structure. No cloning, deletion, refunds or repeated completed-stage charging. Passive weathering continues after cancellation or death.
Use actual pole capsules, cloth triangles, apertures and joint locations in shared collision, interaction, roof-ray and weather calculations. Only intercepted rays reduce exposure, bounded by existing shelter attenuation limits; gaps, orientation and collapsed parts reduce coverage. Wind loading and rain accumulation can cause slipping or collapse. Neither the plan nor a tiny canopy guarantees whole-body shelter, cooling, safety or a rest bonus. Render paid intermediate work and final geometry, including failures, gaps, sag and wetting. Declare short-refuge-inspected, short-refuge-trial, short-refuge-assessed, short-refuge-progress, short-refuge-completed, short-refuge-exposure and short-refuge-stopped events with operation identity, actual inputs/outputs, remaining work, geometry revision, damage and measured uncertainty for replay and subscriptions.
Migration is additive: retain old projects, specimen bounds, uncertainties, shelter contracts and evidence applicability; do not convert old tests into new joint or cover certificates. Record reuse of metrology and shelter exposure/rendering code separately from this independently learned construction function. Implementation and review advance no simulation time.

record.name: Test and assemble a small material-bound canopy
record.function: Assess and construct a finite five-pole shade canopy from measured short materials, with actual grass trials, proof loads, exposure readings and maintenance.
record.costs: Exact IDs or one item:/object: prefix. Inspect/assess/exposure: one round/0.2 energy. Trial: one measured whole pole, one unaltered grass allocation >=0.1 unit, separate real weights; two stages/0.5 each. Assembly: first pole is ridge, next four legs, individually measured; positive explicit dimensions, 0.05 leg joint allowance, actual grass cover mass >=0.5 per roof area and six bindings >=0.02 mass each with personally passed source coupons; four stages/0.75 each. No splicing. Proof requires real load allocations; order names ridge midpoint, first end apex, second end apex, with conservative reaction envelope. Proof/dismantle: two stages/0.5 each. Repair replaces whole equal-quantity grass components in two stages/0.5 each, followed by two actual proof-load stages/0.5 each. Resume/cancel use only own project with empty target/components; unused dimensions zero. Trials use actual x/y layout and zero dimensions. Structure service uses target and zero dimensions. No energy/access means no progress or charge.
record.effects: Paid real geometry and conserved location-bound components; no supplied stock or automatic certification. Five poles form two triangular ends and a ridge; measured lengths bound all dimensions. Grass binding law 50 force per dry mass, wet factor 1–0.5, slip above half breaking force; actual apertures, wear 0.001 dry to 0.004 saturated per round. Explicit proof checks self/wet/wind/load weight, joints, bending, buckling, spread and sag. Conditional finite rays and actual body coverage reuse existing bounded thermal/rest effects and personal-refuge events. No assembly/mastery reward; informative paid trials/exposure use shared deduplicated understanding. Cancel/death releases only surviving unincorporated escrow once; installed parts and passive weathering persist.

reviews.reason: No implemented interface establishes a finite water source, withdraws conserved water, or retains it for a material test. Gathering exposed materials and the existing wet trials are not equivalent. Develop a minimal bank-access, direct-contact and portable-water mechanism. Nearby river terrain permits inspection, not an automatic finding of safe reach, usable water or drinking safety. The remote vine specimen is not acted upon by this review. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Actual paid inspection or a performed wet comparison may establish previously unknown access or material behavior. Subscribe information-confirmed with interface access-water to the existing grounded-understanding source: only the acting observer, qualified new observed information, 0.8 transient amount, cap 1, eight-round duration, refresh repetition and 12-round cooldown; maintained gain 0.035 per eligible event with existing 0.0015 decay and the source's bounded saturation. Share deduplication with probe and material assays: the same access fact or wet-test result cannot pay twice. Repeated known filling, cup fabrication, requesting and learning receive no curiosity or mastery reward. No separate maintained satisfaction source is warranted merely for possessing water; no hydration, nutrition, health or protected mental-account changes are implied.
reviews.visualReview: Declare water-access-inspected, water-cup-progress, water-cup-completed, water-withdrawn, material-contact-wetted, water-spilled, water-cup-failed and water-operation-stopped for subscription validation, alongside existing information-confirmed. Render cups and work footprints at their shared physical coordinates, with visible fill level, wet clay condition, spills and failure remnants. Replay events include actor, source/cup/specimen IDs, location, before/after volumes and masses, paid energy, stage and remaining work. Inspection overlays distinguish observed reachable surface, blocked reach and uncertainty; they must not display a remote test as completed or water as potable.
reviews.specification:
Implement river-contact-water@1 through the current development handoff. Public interface access-water: strict schema {mode:inspect|form-cup|fill|wet|inspect-cup|resume|cancel, target:string, container:string, project:string, quantityMl:integer>=0, x:number,y:number}; unused references empty, unused quantities/coordinates zero. References resolve exact persistent IDs, optionally one appropriate item:/object: prefix, never resource aliases. Targets may also identify an inspected river surface cell. Personal study: two rounds; no simulation time passes during implementation.
State and physical dependencies: use the authoritative river-terrain polygon, shared collision geometry and current water conditions. Add versioned finite surface-water compartments only on actual river cells: initially 10 litres per square metre of wetted area, representing a declared 1 cm withdrawable surface layer, not measured actor knowledge or an unlimited river supply. No automatic replenishment in this minimal version. Persist cell volume, withdrawals, provenance and contamination-unknown status. Inspection reports geometric access and estimated available volume, not potability. If authoritative river geometry does not establish a water surface, report unresolved access without creating one.
Access: actor remains on supported non-water terrain; interaction segment to water or apparatus must be <=0.65, clear of solids, and not require entering water. Coordinate x=26 alone does not establish reach from (25,15). Inspection costs one round/0.2 energy and records actual bank/surface geometry and uncertainty. It neither moves the actor nor wets a remote specimen.
Executable portable precursor: form-cup uses 0.5 kg of explicitly owned wet clay at a clear reachable work footprint, three stages of one round/0.5 energy each. Reject inadequate quantity before allocation; partition material precisely by mass. Persist a hand-formed open cup, 0.1 litre capacity, 0.03 m outer radius, 0.07 m height, clay provenance and remaining wall mass. This is fragile unfired clay, not ceramic. Declare model law: when holding water, lose 1 ml water and 0.1 g wall clay per round into an actual located spill containing clay sediment; at wall mass below 0.45 kg, collapse, spilling remaining water and retaining all clay as wet fragments. Carrying or dropping updates actual location and load; ordinary collision damage also applies. No insulation, sterilization or food-safety effects.
Fill: reachable inspected river compartment plus actual accessible cup, positive quantityMl within free capacity and remaining source volume; one round/0.3 energy. Atomically debit source and credit cup, preserving source/time lineage. Wet: exact locally accessible specimen accepted by an existing material-test contract; one round/0.3 energy. Use 10 ml per 0.1 material unit as the initial versioned contact-water dose, rounded upward to whole ml. Withdraw either from a reachable inspected river compartment for immediate contact or from an explicit local cup. Transfer water into the specimen's tracked moisture and subsequent runoff/evaporation, not an unexplained deletion. Bind this operation to assay-woven-supports so its actual wet stage can consume this dose and proceed only with its own remaining paid work and local specimen. It supplies no pass certificate. No ingestion operation is introduced.
Contracts: persist operation ID, owner, exact escrow IDs, paid stages, actual remaining work and completion flag. Insufficient energy/access pauses without charge. Resume executes only remaining stages; repeat starts a new fully costed operation. Cancellation, incompatible action or death cancels attended multi-round work and releases surviving escrow once at its actual location; never clone, delete or refund used material/effort. Completed cups and passive leakage persist independently. Concurrent withdrawals use atomic shared locks. Migration leaves existing waterless trials paused and existing objects unchanged; never backfill water or rewrite evidence. Record any reused resolver, escrow and wet-trial code separately from this new function.
